title: Multi-Generational Family Gathering Outdoors, 1945 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A heartwarming multi-generational family portrait taken outdoors in a grassy clearing on August 26, 1945, just days after the end of World War II. The group spans four generations, including elderly matriarchs and patriarchs, young couples, spirited children, and a baby held on the grass. The women wear typical mid-1940s short-sleeved floral and polka-dot day dresses with rolled hairstyles, while the men wear fedoras, flat caps, and casual striped shirts.
